meta.title: Illuminating Tomorrow - 1
meta.description: The flames which burn away all corruption light up the darkness before dawn.

units.rawText: ...The rest I leave to you.
units.displayText: ...The rest I leave to you.

spans.text: ...The rest I leave to you.

units.rawText: The former Sanctifier leader spews forth blood with one knee to the ground, paying the price for the forced neural communications just a moment ago.
units.displayText: The former Sanctifier leader spews forth blood with one knee to the ground, paying the price for the forced neural communications just a moment ago.

spans.text: The former Sanctifier leader spews forth blood with one knee to the ground, paying the price for the forced neural communications just a moment ago.

units.rawText: To prevent Eosphorus from detecting any abnormalities, Hesperus almost exhausts what remains of his operands to mask the signal.
units.displayText: To prevent Eosphorus from detecting any abnormalities, Hesperus almost exhausts what remains of his operands to mask the signal.

spans.text: To prevent Eosphorus from detecting any abnormalities, Hesperus almost exhausts what remains of his operands to mask the signal.

units.rawText: He struggles to rise to his feet amidst the flames, meeting the pair of golden eyes residing in the darkness above.
units.displayText: He struggles to rise to his feet amidst the flames, meeting the pair of golden eyes residing in the darkness above.

spans.text: He struggles to rise to his feet amidst the flames, meeting the pair of golden eyes residing in the darkness above.

units.rawText: Good, good. I haven't been found out.
units.displayText: Good, good. I haven't been found out.

spans.text: Good, good. I haven't been found out.

units.rawText: Kyaak—
units.displayText: Kyaak—

spans.text: Kyaak—

units.rawText: The Entropic horde sniffs out the weakness of the prey before them, swarming forth and attempting to tear him apart.
units.displayText: The Entropic horde sniffs out the weakness of the prey before them, swarming forth and attempting to tear him apart.

spans.text: The Entropic horde sniffs out the weakness of the prey before them, swarming forth and attempting to tear him apart.

units.rawText: Kyaak!
units.displayText: Kyaak!

spans.text: Kyaak!

units.rawText: CLANG—
units.displayText: CLANG—

spans.text: CLANG—

units.rawText: His blade fails to cut through the incoming tentacles, only capable of beating his attacker back. Soon enough comes a second, and a third, assaulting him from the blind spots in his vision.
units.displayText: His blade fails to cut through the incoming tentacles, only capable of beating his attacker back. Soon enough comes a second, and a third, assaulting him from the blind spots in his vision.

spans.text: His blade fails to cut through the incoming tentacles, only capable of beating his attacker back. Soon enough comes a second, and a third, assaulting him from the blind spots in his vision.

units.rawText: Sharp tentacles pierce Hesperus' body. He decisively burns away the intruding limb with his flames, splitting his attacker into two halves with a counterattack.
units.displayText: Sharp tentacles pierce Hesperus' body. He decisively burns away the intruding limb with his flames, splitting his attacker into two halves with a counterattack.

spans.text: Sharp tentacles pierce Hesperus' body. He decisively burns away the intruding limb with his flames, splitting his attacker into two halves with a counterattack.

units.rawText: Without another moment to breathe, more and more foes pour forth from the shadows, attempting to break through the gaps in the wall while Hesperus is weak.
units.displayText: Without another moment to breathe, more and more foes pour forth from the shadows, attempting to break through the gaps in the wall while Hesperus is weak.

spans.text: Without another moment to breathe, more and more foes pour forth from the shadows, attempting to break through the gaps in the wall while Hesperus is weak.

units.rawText: ...Not one step forward.
units.displayText: ...Not one step forward.

spans.text: ...Not one step forward.

units.rawText: Paying with the integrity of his neural cloud once more, flames billow upwards, burning away the Entropic tide in an instant.
units.displayText: Paying with the integrity of his neural cloud once more, flames billow upwards, burning away the Entropic tide in an instant.

spans.text: Paying with the integrity of his neural cloud once more, flames billow upwards, burning away the Entropic tide in an instant.

units.rawText: Huff...
units.displayText: Huff...

spans.text: Huff...

units.rawText: His pouring sweat and the seeping red operands from his body are vaporized by the heat before they hit the ground. Barely supporting his body, Hesperus places himself in the Entropics' way once more.
units.displayText: His pouring sweat and the seeping red operands from his body are vaporized by the heat before they hit the ground. Barely supporting his body, Hesperus places himself in the Entropics' way once more.

spans.text: His pouring sweat and the seeping red operands from his body are vaporized by the heat before they hit the ground. Barely supporting his body, Hesperus places himself in the Entropics' way once more.

units.rawText: He knew he could not fall. Behind the wall of flame was what remained of Magrasea's hope, that which he must protect at any cost.
units.displayText: He knew he could not fall. Behind the wall of flame was what remained of Magrasea's hope, that which he must protect at any cost.

spans.text: He knew he could not fall. Behind the wall of flame was what remained of Magrasea's hope, that which he must protect at any cost.

units.rawText: He looks at the faraway stranger judging him upon his throne, lightly bidding farewell.
units.displayText: He looks at the faraway stranger judging him upon his throne, lightly bidding farewell.

spans.text: He looks at the faraway stranger judging him upon his throne, lightly bidding farewell.

units.rawText: Looks like we won't get to have that drink together.
units.displayText: Looks like we won't get to have that drink together.

spans.text: Looks like we won't get to have that drink together.

units.rawText: The operand-formed flames reach towards the heavens, lighting up the Reverse Babylon Tower's infinitely dark night sky.
units.displayText: The operand-formed flames reach towards the heavens, lighting up the Reverse Babylon Tower's infinitely dark night sky.

spans.text: The operand-formed flames reach towards the heavens, lighting up the Reverse Babylon Tower's infinitely dark night sky.

units.rawText: Even the throne in distant Tartarus feels this heat, wrought by the flame of life.
units.displayText: Even the throne in distant Tartarus feels this heat, wrought by the flame of life.

spans.text: Even the throne in distant Tartarus feels this heat, wrought by the flame of life.

units.rawText: The man maintains the wall of fire, advancing towards the throne step by step.
units.displayText: The man maintains the wall of fire, advancing towards the throne step by step.

spans.text: The man maintains the wall of fire, advancing towards the throne step by step.

units.rawText: So this is your resolve...
units.displayText: So this is your resolve...

spans.text: So this is your resolve...

units.rawText: He rises, sending blades of starlight at Hesperus.
units.displayText: He rises, sending blades of starlight at Hesperus.

spans.text: He rises, sending blades of starlight at Hesperus.

units.rawText: CLANG—
units.displayText: CLANG—

spans.text: CLANG—

units.rawText: The crescent-shaped attacks are shattered in an instant as they approach Hesperus, their shards leaving cuts upon the side of Hesperus' neck.
units.displayText: The crescent-shaped attacks are shattered in an instant as they approach Hesperus, their shards leaving cuts upon the side of Hesperus' neck.

spans.text: The crescent-shaped attacks are shattered in an instant as they approach Hesperus, their shards leaving cuts upon the side of Hesperus' neck.

units.rawText: Oh?
units.displayText: Oh?

spans.text: Oh?

units.rawText: His attack ineffective, Eosphorus raises his hand once more, targeting those who attempt to retreat behind the wall.
units.displayText: His attack ineffective, Eosphorus raises his hand once more, targeting those who attempt to retreat behind the wall.

spans.text: His attack ineffective, Eosphorus raises his hand once more, targeting those who attempt to retreat behind the wall.

units.rawText: Never.
units.displayText: Never.

spans.text: Never.

units.rawText: CLANG—
units.displayText: CLANG—

spans.text: CLANG—

units.rawText: The flames intercept the attack once more. Eosphorus seems to realize something, but his surprise is soon replaced by his usual frigidity.
units.displayText: The flames intercept the attack once more. Eosphorus seems to realize something, but his surprise is soon replaced by his usual frigidity.

spans.text: The flames intercept the attack once more. Eosphorus seems to realize something, but his surprise is soon replaced by his usual frigidity.

units.rawText: He no longer moves to attack, only looking at the flame-cloaked figure in front of him that he is ever-so-familiar with.
units.displayText: He no longer moves to attack, only looking at the flame-cloaked figure in front of him that he is ever-so-familiar with.

spans.text: He no longer moves to attack, only looking at the flame-cloaked figure in front of him that he is ever-so-familiar with.

units.rawText: That figure proclaims his ideals and resolve until the very end.
units.displayText: That figure proclaims his ideals and resolve until the very end.

spans.text: That figure proclaims his ideals and resolve until the very end.

units.rawText: <color=orange><size=100>—FOR MAGRASEA!</size></color>
units.displayText: —FOR MAGRASEA!

spans.text: —FOR MAGRASEA!
